item.title: CVE-2025-62860: thousands of Bitcoin nodes disabled DoS protection
item.description:
CVE-2025-62860: thousands of Bitcoin nodes disabled DoS protection

In September 2025, Martin Zumsande stumbled upon a bunch of misbehaving Bitcoin Knots nodes. This led us to discover a widespread configuration bug which exposed Bitcoin Knots and Bitcoin Core nodes to privacy leaks and various DoS vectors.

It already feels far away, but until not too long ago Bitcoin was targeted by a campaign of disinformation and harassment to promote a misguided fork coin. This all started when a group of Bitcoin enthusiasts, vocal on social media, objected to a default relay policy change in Bitcoin Core. They decided to turn to Bitcoin Knots as an alternative, at the time still merely a fork of Bitcoin Core’s software, not yet of the Bitcoin network.
